# A landing that the forge defers is not tried again at every pass while the pull request outranks the ready tasks.
# One P0 task a and four P3 tasks. Two slots, BATCH=8. Task a ends at once. The P3 task b holds its slot until a third task started, so a waits while P3 tasks are ready.
# The forge defers every merge while a task runs (forge/fail-merge). The cause goes away by itself when the tasks end, as a transient cause does.
# The early landing of a is tried once and is deferred. The swarm then starts the P3 tasks, and a lands when no run is live.
# The claim is a count: one failed early landing, and not one at every pass.
isolate
swarmfakes

env BATCH=8
exec beehaveswarm item add swarm swarm-1 --title 'The swarm' --body-file backlog.txt
exec beehaveswarm run swarm-1 swarm --workflow swarm/workflow.star

# One early landing was deferred.
exec awk '/^MergeFail / {n++} END {if (n != 1) {print "REPEATED EARLY LANDING: " n " deferred landings, want 1"; exit 1}}' forge/calls.log

# No task hit its hang guard.
! exists harness-fault

# Everything landed.
grep -count=5 '^MergePR ' forge/calls.log
exec grep -rhao '5 landed, 0 need a person, 0 not started' state

-- forge/fail-merge --
on
-- backlog.txt --
P0	zero-a	a.txt
P3	three-b	after-four b.txt
P3	three-c	low c.txt
P3	three-d	low d.txt
P3	three-e	low e.txt
